status: exploratory model, fixed before consequence enumeration
N: the preceding written expression is called NAME; NAME is mentioned as a written designation at declaration
C: the preceding written description gives the composition/characterization of OBJECT; the target refers to an object/type
unit_start: physical line start, or first group after the preceding marker's single target on that line
definition_body: every group from unit_start to marker, exact order, none omitted
term_scope: one global stable dictionary across the seven records in the inherited page reading order; this order is not proven authorial discourse
sequential_application: only names whose declaration target precedes the occurrence may be expanded; definitions are expanded with currently available names, recursively; later definitions are not used retroactively in this mode
retrospective_application: full proposed dictionary recursively expanded; disclosed future definitions, never counted as sequential success
failure: missing body/target, incompatible duplicate definition, or dependency cycle blocks the corresponding fixed candidate; no extent repair
unknowns: all nonmarker leaf forms remain semantically untranslated; a mechanical expansion is not a translated meaning
role_counting: declaration target is quotation in N and object reference in C; uses in a definition body are distinguished from free later text
selection_exposure: whole f83r packet previously used by P12/P23/W91; qokedy .20/.21 motivated hypothesis; no blind scoring or reserved access
